title.narrative: CHIEAM - ONE WATER: FOR A JUST, EFFICIENT AND SUSTAINABLE MANAGEMENT OF WATER IN THE MEDITERRANEAN AREA.
CIHEAM - ONE WATER -PER UNA GESTIONE GIUSTA, EFFICIENTE E SOSTENIBILE DELL'ACQUA NELL'AREA DEL MEDITERRANEO

description.narrative: L'iniziativa “One Water: per una gestione equa, efficiente e sostenibile dell'acqua nell'area del Mediterraneo” mira a rafforzare la cooperazione tra i Paesi dell'area MENA e dei Balcani nel settore idrico, attraverso l'avvio di un processo multi-stakeholder finalizzato alla gestione sostenibile delle risorse idriche, in particolare in vista del primo “Forum Euro Mediterraneo dell'Acqua"

The initiative "One Water: for a fair, efficient and sustainable management of water in the Mediterranean area" aims to strengthen cooperation between the countries of the MENA area and the Balkans in the water sector, through the launch of a multi-stakeholder process aimed at the sustainable management of water resources, in particular in view of the first "Euro Mediterranean Water Forum".

tag.narrative: By 2030, expand international cooperation and capacity-building support to developing countries in water- and sanitation-related activities and programmes, including water harvesting, desalination, water efficiency, wastewater treatment, recycling and reuse technologies
By 2030, implement integrated water resources management at all levels, including through transboundary cooperation as appropriate

By 2030, substantially increase water-use efficiency across all sectors and ensure sustainable withdrawals and supply of freshwater to address water scarcity and substantially reduce the number of people suffering from water scarcity

Enhance North-South, South-South and triangular regional and international cooperation on and access to science, technology and innovation and enhance knowledge-sharing on mutually agreed terms, including through improved coordination among existing mechanisms, in particular at the United Nations level, and through a global technology facilitation mechanism
Ensure availability and sustainable management of water and sanitation for all
Strengthen the means of implementation and revitalize the global partnership for sustainable development
Support and strengthen the participation of local communities in improving water and sanitation management
